attributes.title: SAEM27 Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
SAEM27 runs Tuesday through Friday, May 18 to 21, 2027, at the San Francisco Marriott Marquis on Mission Street. The meeting is the main annual gathering of the Society for Academic Emergency Medicine, so the program leans toward research presentations, teaching and the academic side of emergency practice rather than a pure board-review format.

As of our check, SAEM had not posted fees, credit totals or hotel rates for 2027. The society says a reservation link for its room block will appear once registration opens. If you plan to present, watch the SAEM27 submission calendar on the society site for abstract deadlines.
